    • Method Detail

      • onAdd

        public void onAdd​(@NonNull
                  Node node)
        Description copied from interface: NodeStateListener
        Invoked when a node is first added to the cluster.

        The node is not up yet at this point. NodeStateListener.onUp(Node) will be notified later if the driver successfully connects to the node (provided that a session is opened and the node is not ignored), or receives a topology event for it.

        This method is not invoked for the contact points provided at initialization. It is however for new nodes discovered during the full node list refresh after the first connection.

        Specified by:
        onAdd in interface NodeStateListener
